ayahs.textArabic: اَتٰىٓ اَمْرُ اللّٰهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوْهُ ۗسُبْحٰنَهٗ وَتَعٰلٰى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Atā amrullāhi falā tasta‘jilūh(u), subḥānahū wa ta‘ālā ‘ammā yusyrikūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: GOD'S JUDGMENT is [bound to] come: do not, therefore, call for its speedy advent! Limitless is He in His glory and sublimely exalted above anything to which men may ascribe a share in His divinity!

ayahs.textArabic: يُنَزِّلُ الْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةَ بِالرُّوْحِ مِنْ اَمْرِهٖ عَلٰى مَنْ يَّشَاۤءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهٖٓ اَنْ اَنْذِرُوْٓا اَنَّهٗ لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّآ اَنَا۠ فَاتَّقُوْنِ
ayahs.textLatin: Yunazzilul-malā'ikata bir-rūḥi min amrihī ‘alā may yasyā'u min ‘ibādihī an anżirū annahū lā ilāha illā ana fattaqūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: He causes the angels to descend with this divine inspiration, [bestowed] at His behest upon whomever He wills of His servants: "Warn [all human beings] that there is no deity save Me: be, therefore, conscious of Me!"

ayahs.textArabic: خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّۗ تَعٰلٰى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqq(i), ta‘ālā ‘ammā yusyrikūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: He has created the heavens and the earth in accordance with [an inner] truth; sublimely exalted is He above anything to which men may ascribe a share in His divinity!

ayahs.textArabic: خَلَقَ الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ نُّطْفَةٍ فَاِذَا هُوَ خَصِيْمٌ مُّبِيْنٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Khalaqal-insāna min nuṭfatin fa iżā huwa khaṣīmum mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: He creates man out of a [mere] drop of sperm: and lo! this same being shows himself endowed with the power to think and to argue!

ayahs.textArabic: وَالْاَنْعَامَ خَلَقَهَا لَكُمْ فِيْهَا دِفْءٌ وَّمَنَافِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-an‘āma khalaqahā lakum fīhā dif'uw wa manāfi‘u wa minhā ta'kulūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And He creates cattle: you derive warmth from them, and [various other] uses; and from them you obtain food;

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَكُمْ فِيْهَا جَمَالٌ حِيْنَ تُرِيْحُوْنَ وَحِيْنَ تَسْرَحُوْنَۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lakum fīhā jamālun ḥīna turīḥūna wa ḥīna tasraḥūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and you find beauty in them when you drive them home in the evenings and when you take them out to pasture in the mornings.

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَحْمِلُ اَثْقَالَكُمْ اِلٰى بَلَدٍ لَّمْ تَكُوْنُوْا بٰلِغِيْهِ اِلَّا بِشِقِّ الْاَنْفُسِۗ اِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوْفٌ رَّحِيْمٌۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa taḥmilu aṡqālakum ilā baladil lam takūnū bāligīhi illā bisyiqqil-anfus(i), inna rabbakum lara'ūfur raḥīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And they carry your loads to [many] a place which [otherwise] you would be unable to reach without great hardship to yourselves. Verily, your Sustainer is most compassionate, a dispenser of grace!

ayahs.textArabic: وَّالْخَيْلَ وَالْبِغَالَ وَالْحَمِيْرَ لِتَرْكَبُوْهَا وَزِيْنَةًۗ وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-khaila wal-bigāla wal-ḥamīra litarkabūhā wa zīnah(tan), wa yakhluqu mā lā ta‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And (it is He who creates] horses and mules and asses for you to ride, as well as for [their] beauty: and He will yet create things of which [today] you have no knowledge.

ayahs.textArabic: وَعَلَى اللّٰهِ قَصْدُ السَّبِيْلِ وَمِنْهَا جَاۤىِٕرٌ ۗوَلَوْ شَاۤءَ لَهَدٰىكُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ‘alallāhi qaṣdus-sabīli wa minhā jā'ir(un), wa lau syā'a lahadākum ajma‘īn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [because He is your Creator,] it rests with God alone to show you the right path: yet there is [many a one] who swerves from it. However, had He so willed, He would have guided you all aright.

ayahs.textArabic: هُوَ الَّذِيْٓ اَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاۤءِ مَاۤءً لَّكُمْ مِّنْهُ شَرَابٌ وَّمِنْهُ شَجَرٌ فِيْهِ تُسِيْمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Huwal-lażī anzala minas-samā'i mā'al lakum minhu syarābuw wa minhu syajarun fīhi tusīmūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: It is He who sends down water from the skies; you drink thereof, and thereof [drink] the plants upon which you pasture your beasts;

ayahs.textArabic: يُنْۢبِتُ لَكُمْ بِهِ الزَّرْعَ وَالزَّيْتُوْنَ وَالنَّخِيْلَ وَالْاَعْنَابَ وَمِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِۗ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yumbitu lakum bihiz-zar‘a waz-zaitūna wan-nakhīla wal-a‘nāba wa min kulliṡ-ṡamarāt(i), inna fī żālika la'āyatal liqaumiy yatafakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and] by virtue thereof He causes crops to grow for you, and olive trees, and date palms, and grapes, and all [other] kinds of fruit: in this, behold, there is a message indeed for people who think!

ayahs.textArabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَۙ وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَ ۗوَالنُّجُوْمُ مُسَخَّرٰتٌۢ بِاَمْرِهٖ ۗاِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَّعْقِلُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa sakhkhara lakumul-laila wan-nahār(a), wasy-syamsa wal-qamar(a), wan-nujūmu musakhkharātum bi'amrih(ī), inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy ya‘qilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And He has made the night and the day and the sun and the moon subservient [to His laws, so that they be of use] to you; and all the stars are subservient to His command: in this, behold, there are messages indeed for people who use their reason!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا ذَرَاَ لَكُمْ فِى الْاَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفًا اَلْوَانُهٗ ۗاِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَّذَّكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā żara'a lakum fil-arḍi mukhtalifan alwānuh(ū), inna fī żālika la'āyatal liqaumiy yażżakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And all the [beauty of] many hues-which He has created for you on earth: in this, behold, there is a message for people who (are willing to] take it to heart!

ayahs.textArabic: وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ سَخَّرَ الْبَحْرَ لِتَأْكُلُوْا مِنْهُ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَّتَسْتَخْرِجُوْا مِنْهُ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُوْنَهَاۚ وَتَرَى الْفُلْكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيْهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوْا مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa huwal-lażī sakhkharal-baḥra lita'kulū minhu laḥman ṭariyyaw wa tastakhrijū minhu ḥilyatan talbasūnahā, wa taral-fulka mawākhira fīhi wa litabtagū min faḍlihī wa la‘allakum tasykurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And He it is who has made the sea subservient [to His laws], so that you might eat fresh meat from it, and take from it gems which you may wear. And on that [very sea] one sees ships ploughing through the waves, so that you might [be able to] go forth in quest of some of His bounty, and thus have cause to be grateful [to Him].

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَلْقٰى فِى الْاَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ اَنْ تَمِيْدَ بِكُمْ وَاَنْهٰرًا وَّسُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa alqā fil-arḍi rawāsiya an tamīda bikum wa anhāraw wa subulal la‘allakum tahtadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And he has placed firm mountains on earth, lest it sway with you, and rivers and paths, so that you might find your way,

ayahs.textArabic: وَعَلٰمٰتٍۗ وَبِالنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ‘alāmāt(in), wa bin-najmi hum yahtadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: as well as [various other] means of orientation: for [it is] by the stars that men find their way.

ayahs.textArabic: اَفَمَنْ يَّخْلُقُ كَمَنْ لَّا يَخْلُقُۗ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Afamay yakhluqu kamal lā yakhluq(u), afalā tażakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: IS, THEN, HE who creates comparable to any [being] that cannot create? Will you not, then, bethink yourselves?

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنْ تَعُدُّوْا نِعْمَةَ اللّٰهِ لَا تُحْصُوْهَا ۗاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَغَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa in ta‘uddū ni‘matallāhi lā tuḥṣūhā, innallāha lagafūrur raḥīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: For, should you try to count God's blessings, you could never compute them! Behold, God is indeed much-forgiving, a dispenser of grace;

ayahs.textArabic: وَاللّٰهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّوْنَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wallāhu ya‘lamu mā tusirrūna wa mā tu‘linūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and God knows all that you keep secret as well as all that you bring into the open.

ayahs.textArabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ يَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ لَا يَخْلُقُوْنَ شَيْـًٔا وَّهُمْ يُخْلَقُوْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-lażīna yad‘ūna min dūnillāhi  lā yakhluqūna syai'aw wa hum yukhlaqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now those beings that some people invoke beside God cannot create anything, since they themselves are but created:

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْوَاتٌ غَيْرُ اَحْيَاۤءٍ ۗوَمَا يَشْعُرُوْنَۙ اَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Amwātun gairu aḥyā'(in), wa mā yasy‘urūna ayyāna yub‘aṡūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: they are dead, not living, and they do not [even] know when they will be raised from the dead!

ayahs.textArabic: اِلٰهُكُمْ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌ ۚفَالَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ قُلُوْبُهُمْ مُّنْكِرَةٌ وَّهُمْ مُّسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ilāhukum ilāhuw wāḥid(un), fal-lażīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati qulūbuhum munkiratuw wa hum mustakbirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Your God is the One God: but because of their false pride, the hearts of those who do not believe in the life to come refuse to admit this [truth].

ayahs.textArabic: لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّوْنَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُوْنَ ۗاِنَّهٗ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُسْتَكْبِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Lā jarama annallāha ya‘lamu mā yusirrūna wa mā yu‘linūn(a), innahū lā yuḥibbul-mustakbirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Truly, God knows all that they keep secret as well as all that they bring into the open -[and,] behold, He does not love those who are given to arrogance,

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَا قِيْلَ لَهُمْ مَّاذَآ اَنْزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۙقَالُوْٓا اَسَاطِيْرُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā qīla lahum māżā anzala rabbukum, qālū asāṭīrul-awwalīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [who], whenever they are asked, "What is it that your Sustainer has bestowed from on high?"-are wont to answer, "Fables of ancient times!"

ayahs.textArabic: لِيَحْمِلُوْٓا اَوْزَارَهُمْ كَامِلَةً يَّوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ ۙوَمِنْ اَوْزَارِ الَّذِيْنَ يُضِلُّوْنَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۗ اَلَا سَاۤءَ مَا يَزِرُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Liyaḥmilū auzārahum kāmilatay yaumal-qiyāmah(ti), wa min auzāril-lażīna yuḍillūnahum bigairi ‘ilm(in), alā sā'a mā yazirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, on Resurrection Day they shall bear the full weight of their own burdens, as well as some of the burdens of those ignorant ones whom they have led astray: oh, how evil the load with which they shall be burdened!

ayahs.textArabic: قَدْ مَكَرَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَاَتَى اللّٰهُ بُنْيَانَهُمْ مِّنَ الْقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّقْفُ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ وَاَتٰىهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qad makaral-lażīna min qablihim fa atallāhu bun-yānahum minal-qawā‘idi fa kharra ‘alaihimus-saqfu min fauqihim wa atāhumul-‘ażābu min ḥaiṡu lā yasy‘urūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Those who lived before them did, too, devise many a blasphemy -whereupon God visited with destruction all that they had ever built, [striking] at its very foundations, so that the roof fell in upon them from above and suffering befell them without their having perceived whence it came.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ يُخْزِيْهِمْ وَيَقُوْلُ اَيْنَ شُرَكَاۤءِيَ الَّذِيْنَ كُنْتُمْ تُشَاۤقُّوْنَ فِيْهِمْ ۗقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوا الْعِلْمَ اِنَّ الْخِزْيَ الْيَوْمَ وَالسُّوْۤءَ عَلَى الْكٰفِرِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma yaumal-qiyāmati yukhzīhim wa yaqūlu aina syurakā'iyal-lażīna kuntum tusyāqqūna fīhim, qālal-lażīna ūtul-‘ilma innal-khizyal-yauma was-sū'a ‘alal-kāfirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And then, on Resurrection Day, He will cover them [all] with ignominy, and will say: "Where, now, are those beings to whom you ascribed a share in My divinity, [and] for whose sake you cut yourselves off [from My guidance]?" [Whereupon] those who [in their lifetime] were endowed with knowledge will say: "Verily, ignominy and misery [have fallen] this day upon those who have been denying the truth-

ayahs.textArabic: الَّذِيْنَ تَتَوَفّٰىهُمُ الْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةُ ظَالِمِيْٓ اَنْفُسِهِمْ ۖفَاَلْقَوُا السَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ مِنْ سُوْۤءٍ ۗبَلٰىٓ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيْمٌۢ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażīna tatawaffāhumul-malā'ikatu ẓālimī anfusihim, fa alqawus-salama mā kunnā na‘malu min sū'(in), balā innallāha ‘alīmum bimā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: those whom the angels have gathered in death while they were still sinning against themselves!" Then will they [who are thus arraigned] proffer their submission, [saying:] "We did not [mean to] do any evil! [But they will be answered:] "Yea, verily, God has full knowledge of all that you were doing!

ayahs.textArabic: فَادْخُلُوْٓا اَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَا ۗفَلَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى الْمُتَكَبِّرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fadkhulū abwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā, fa labi'sa maṡwal-mutakabbirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, enter the gates of hell, therein to abide!" And evil, indeed, shall be the state of all who are given to false pride!

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَقِيْلَ لِلَّذِيْنَ اتَّقَوْا مَاذَآ اَنْزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۗقَالُوْا خَيْرًا ۚلِلَّذِيْنَ اَحْسَنُوْا فِيْ هٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ  ۗوَلَدَارُ الْاٰخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ ۗوَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ الْمُتَّقِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qīla lil-lażīnattaqau māżā anzala rabbukum, qālū khairā(n), lil-lażīna aḥsanū fī hāżihid-dun-yā ḥasanah(tun), wa ladārul-ākhirati khair(un), wa lani‘ma dārul-muttaqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But [when] those who are conscious of God are asked, "What is it that your Sustainer has bestowed from on high?" -they answer, "Goodness supreme!" Good fortune awaits, in this world, all who persevere in doing good; but their ultimate state will be far better still: for, how excellent indeed will be the state of the God-conscious [in the life to come]!

ayahs.textArabic: جَنّٰتُ عَدْنٍ يَّدْخُلُوْنَهَا تَجْرِيْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ لَهُمْ فِيْهَا مَا يَشَاۤءُوْنَ ۗ كَذٰلِكَ يَجْزِى اللّٰهُ الْمُتَّقِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Jannātu ‘adniy yadkhulūnahā tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru lahum fīhā mā yasyā'ūn(a), każālika yajzillāhul-muttaqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Gardens of perpetual bliss will they enter - [gardens] through which running waters flow - having therein all that they might desire. Thus will God reward those who are conscious of Him-

ayahs.textArabic: الَّذِيْنَ تَتَوَفّٰىهُمُ الْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةُ طَيِّبِيْنَ ۙيَقُوْلُوْنَ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ادْخُلُوا الْجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażīna tatawafāhumul-malā'ikatu ṭayyibīn(a), yaqūlūna salāmun ‘alaikumudkhulul-jannata bimā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: those whom the angels gather in death while they are in a state of inner purity, greeting them thus: "Peace be upon you! Enter paradise by virtue of what you were doing [in life]!"

ayahs.textArabic: هَلْ يَنْظُرُوْنَ اِلَّآ اَنْ تَأْتِيَهُمُ الْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةُ اَوْ يَأْتِيَ اَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۗ كَذٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ ۗوَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ اللّٰهُ وَلٰكِنْ كَانُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Hal yanẓurūna illā an ta'tiyahumul-malā'ikatu au ya'tiya amru rabbik(a), każālika fa‘alal-lażīna min qablihim, wa mā ẓalamahumullāhu wa lākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: ARE THEY [who deny the truth] but waiting for the angels to appear unto them, or for God's judgment to become manifest? Even thus did behave those [stubborn sinners] who lived before their time; and [when they were destroyed,] it was not God who wronged them, but it was they who had wronged themselves:

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا عَمِلُوْا وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa aṣābahum sayyi'ātu mā ‘amilū wa ḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihī yastahzi'ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for all the evil that they had done fell [back] upon them, and they were overwhelmed by the very thing which they had been wont to deride.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ اَشْرَكُوْا لَوْ شَاۤءَ اللّٰهُ مَا عَبَدْنَا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ مِنْ شَيْءٍ نَّحْنُ وَلَآ اٰبَاۤؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِنْ دُوْنِهٖ مِنْ شَيْءٍ ۗ كَذٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ ۚفَهَلْ عَلَى الرُّسُلِ اِلَّا الْبَلٰغُ الْمُبِيْنُ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālal-lażīna asyrakū lau syā'allāhu mā ‘abadnā min dūnihī min syai'in naḥnu wa lā ābā'unā wa lā ḥarramnā min dūnihī min syai'(in), każālika fa‘alal-lażīna min qablihim, fahal ‘alar-rusuli illal-balāgul-mubīn(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now they who ascribe divinity to aught beside God say, "Had God so willed, we would not have worshipped aught but Him - neither we nor our forefathers; nor would we have declared aught as forbidden without a commandment from Him." Even thus did speak those [sinners] who lived before their time; but, then, are the apostles bound to do more than clearly deliver the message [entrusted to them]?

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِيْ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ رَّسُوْلًا اَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَاجْتَنِبُوا الطَّاغُوْتَۚ فَمِنْهُمْ مَّنْ هَدَى اللّٰهُ وَمِنْهُمْ مَّنْ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الضَّلٰلَةُ ۗ فَسِيْرُوْا فِى الْاَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوْا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad ba‘aṡnā fī kulli ummatir rasūlan ani‘budullāha wajtanibuṭ-ṭāgūt(a), fa minhum man hadallāhu wa minhum man ḥaqqat ‘alaihiḍ-ḍalālah(tu), fa sīrū fil-arḍi fanẓurū kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-mukażżibīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And indeed, within every community have We raised up an apostle [entrusted with this message]: "Worship God, and shun the powers of evil!" And among those [past generations] were people whom God graced with His guidance, just as there was among them [many a one] who inevitably fell prey to grievous error: go, then, about the earth and behold what happened in the end to those who gave the lie to the truth!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنْ تَحْرِصْ عَلٰى هُدٰىهُمْ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهْدِيْ مَنْ يُّضِلُّ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ نّٰصِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: In taḥriṣ ‘alā hudāhum fa innallāha lā yahdī may yuḍillu wa mā lahum min nāṣirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [As for those who are bent on denying the truth-] though thou be ever so eager to show them the right way, [know that,] verily, God does not bestow His guidance upon any whom He judges to have gone astray; and such shall have none to succour them [on Resurrection Day].

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَقْسَمُوْا بِاللّٰهِ جَهْدَ اَيْمَانِهِمْۙ  لَا يَبْعَثُ اللّٰهُ مَنْ يَّمُوْتُۗ بَلٰى وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّا وَّلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa aqsamū billāhi jahda aimānihim, lā yab‘aṡullāhu may yamūt(u), balā wa‘dan ‘alaihi ḥaqqaw wa lākinna akṡaran-nāsi lā ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: As it is, they swear by God with their most solemn oaths, "Never will God raise from the dead anyone who has died!" Yea indeed! [This very thing has God promised] by a promise which He has willed upon Himself; but most people know it not.

ayahs.textArabic: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِيْ يَخْتَلِفُوْنَ فِيْهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اَنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا كٰذِبِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Liyubayyina lahumul-lażī yakhtalifūna fīhi wa liya‘lamal-lażīna kafarū annahum kānū-kāżibīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [He will resurrect them] to the end that He might make clear unto them all whereon they [now] hold divergent views, and that they who are bent on denying the truth [of resurrection] might come to know that they were liars.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَيْءٍ اِذَآ اَرَدْنٰهُ اَنْ نَّقُوْلَ لَهٗ كُنْ فَيَكُوْنُ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Innamā qaulunā lisyai'in iżā aradnāhu an naqūla lahū kun fa yakūn(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Whenever We will anything to be, We but say unto it Our word "Be" -and it is.

ayahs.textArabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ هَاجَرُوْا فِى اللّٰهِ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوْا لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ فِى الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً  ۗوَلَاَجْرُ الْاٰخِرَةِ اَكْبَرُۘ لَوْ كَانُوْا يَعْلَمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-lażīna hājarū fillāhi mim ba‘di mā ẓulimū lanubawwi'annahum fid-dun-yā ḥasanah(tan), wa la'ajrul-ākhirati akbar(u), lau kānū ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: NOW as for those who forsake the domain of evil in the cause of God, after having suffered wrong [on account of their faith] - We shall most certainly grant them a station of good fortune in this world: but their reward in the life to come will be far greater yet. If they [who deny the truth] could but understand

ayahs.textArabic: الَّذِيْنَ صَبَرُوْا وَعَلٰى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażīna ṣabarū wa ‘alā rabbihim yatawakkalūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: those who, having attained to patience in adversity, in their Sustainer place their trust!

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ اِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوْحِيْٓ اِلَيْهِمْ  فَسْـَٔلُوْٓا اَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā arsalnā min qablika illā rijālan nūḥī ilaihim fas'alū ahlaż-żikri in kuntum lā ta‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND [even] before thy time, [O Muhammad,] We never sent [as Our apostles] any but [mortal] men, whom We inspired: and if you have not [yet] realized this, ask the followers of [earlier] revelation,"

ayahs.textArabic: بِالْبَيِّنٰتِ وَالزُّبُرِۗ وَاَنْزَلْنَآ اِلَيْكَ الذِّكْرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ اِلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Bil-bayyināti waz-zubur(i), wa anzalnā ilaikaż-żikra litubayyina lin-nāsi mā nuzzila ilaihim wa la‘allahum yatafakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and they will tell you that their prophets, too, were but mortal men whom We had endowed] with all evidence of the truth and with books of divine wisdom. And upon thee [too] have We bestowed from on high this reminder, so that thou might make clear unto mankind all that has ever been thus bestowed upon them, and that they might take thought.

ayahs.textArabic: اَفَاَمِنَ الَّذِيْنَ مَكَرُوا السَّيِّاٰتِ اَنْ يَّخْسِفَ اللّٰهُ بِهِمُ الْاَرْضَ اَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Afa aminal-lażīna makarus-sayyi'āti ay yakhsifallāhu bihimul-arḍa au ya'tiyahumul-‘ażābu min ḥaiṡu lā yasy‘urūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Can, then, they who devise evil schemes ever feel sure that God will not cause the earth to swallow them, or that suffering will not befall them without their perceiving whence [it came]? -

ayahs.textArabic: اَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ فِيْ تَقَلُّبِهِمْ فَمَا هُمْ بِمُعْجِزِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Au ya'khużahum fī taqallubihim famā hum bimu‘jizīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: or that He will not take them to task [suddenly] in the midst of their comings and goings, without their being able to elude [Him],

ayahs.textArabic: اَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ عَلٰى تَخَوُّفٍۗ فَاِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوْفٌ رَّحِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Au ya'khużahum ‘alā takhawwuf(in), fa inna rabbakum lara'ūfur raḥīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: or take them to task through slow decay? And yet, behold, your Sustainer is most compassionate, a dispenser of grace!

ayahs.textArabic: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اِلٰى مَا خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ يَّتَفَيَّؤُا ظِلٰلُهٗ عَنِ الْيَمِيْنِ وَالشَّمَاۤىِٕلِ سُجَّدًا لِّلّٰهِ وَهُمْ دَاخِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Awalam yarau ilā mā khalaqallāhu min syai'iy yatafayya'u ẓilāluhū ‘anil-yamīni wasy-syamā'ili sujjadal lillāhi wa hum dākhirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: HAVE, THEN, they [who deny the truth] never considered any of the things that God has created _ (how] their shadows turn right and left, prostrating themselves before God and utterly submissive [to His will]?

ayahs.textArabic: وَلِلّٰهِ يَسْجُدُ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِى الْاَرْضِ مِنْ دَاۤبَّةٍ وَّالْمَلٰۤىِٕكَةُ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lillāhi yasjudu mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍi min dābbatiw wal-malā'ikatu wa hum yastakbirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: For, before God prostrates itself all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth - every beast that moves, and the angels: [even] these do not bear themselves with false pride:

ayahs.textArabic: يَخَافُوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ مِّنْ فَوْقِهِمْ وَيَفْعَلُوْنَ مَا يُؤْمَرُوْنَ ࣖ ۩
ayahs.textLatin: Yakhāfūna rabbahum min fauqihim wa yaf‘alūna mā yu'marūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: they fear their Sustainer high above them, and do whatever they are bidden to do.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَقَالَ اللّٰهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوْٓا اِلٰهَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِۚ اِنَّمَا هُوَ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌ فَاِيَّايَ فَارْهَبُوْنِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālallāhu lā tattakhiżū ilāhainiṡnain(i), innamā huwa ilāhuw wāḥidun fa iyyāya farhabūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And God has said: "Do not take to worshipping two [or more] deities. He is the One and Only God: hence, of Me, of Me alone stand in awe!"

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَهٗ مَا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَلَهُ الدِّيْنُ وَاصِبًاۗ اَفَغَيْرَ اللّٰهِ تَتَّقُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lahū mā fis-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa lahud-dīnu wāṣibā(n), afagairallāhi tattaqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And His is all that is in the heavens and on earth, and to Him [alone] obedience is always due: will you, then, pay reverence to aught but Him?

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا بِكُمْ مِّنْ نِّعْمَةٍ فَمِنَ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ اِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فَاِلَيْهِ تَجْـَٔرُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā bikum min ni‘matin fa minallāhi ṡumma iżā massakumuḍ-ḍurru fa ilaihi taj'arūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: For, whatever good thing comes to you, comes from God; and whenever harm befalls you, it is unto Him that you cry for help

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ اِذَا كَشَفَ الضُّرَّ عَنْكُمْ اِذَا فَرِيْقٌ مِّنْكُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma iżā kasyafaḍ-ḍurra ‘ankum iżā farīqum minkum birabbihim yusyrikūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: yet as soon as He has removed the harm from you, lo! some of you [begin to] ascribe to other powers a share 'in their Sustainer's divinity

ayahs.textArabic: لِيَكْفُرُوْا بِمَآ اٰتَيْنٰهُمْۗ فَتَمَتَّعُوْاۗ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Liyakfurū bimā ātaināhum, fa tamatta‘ū fa saufa ta‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [as if] to prove their ingratitude for all that We have granted them! Enjoy, then, your [brief] life: but in time you will come to know [the truth]!

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَجْعَلُوْنَ لِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ نَصِيْبًا مِّمَّا رَزَقْنٰهُمْۗ تَاللّٰهِ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنْتُمْ تَفْتَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yaj‘alūna limā lā ya‘lamūna naṣībam mimmā razaqnāhum, tallāhi latus'alunna ‘ammā kuntum taftarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: As it is, they ascribe - out of what We provide for them as sustenance - a share unto things of which they know nothing. By God, you shall most certainly be called to account for all your false imagery!

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَجْعَلُوْنَ لِلّٰهِ الْبَنٰتِ سُبْحٰنَهٗۙ وَلَهُمْ مَّا يَشْتَهُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yaj‘alūna lillāhil-banāti subḥānah(ū), wa lahum mā yasytahūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [thus, too,] they ascribe daughters unto God, who is limitless in His glory - whereas for themselves [they would choose, if they could, only] what they desire:

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَا بُشِّرَ اَحَدُهُمْ بِالْاُنْثٰى ظَلَّ وَجْهُهٗ مُسْوَدًّا وَّهُوَ كَظِيْمٌۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā busysyira aḥaduhum bil-unṡā ẓalla wajhuhū muswaddaw wa huwa kaẓīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, whenever any of them is given the glad tiding of [the birth of] a girl, his face darkens, and he is filled with suppressed anger,

ayahs.textArabic: يَتَوٰرٰى مِنَ الْقَوْمِ مِنْ سُوْۤءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهٖۗ اَيُمْسِكُهٗ عَلٰى هُوْنٍ اَمْ يَدُسُّهٗ فِى التُّرَابِۗ  اَلَا سَاۤءَ مَا يَحْكُمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yatawārā minal-qaumi min sū'i mā busysyira bih(ī), ayumsikuhū ‘alā hūnin am yadussuhū fit-turāb(i), alā sā'a mā yaḥkumūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: avoiding all people because of the [alleged] evil of the glad tiding which he has received, [and debating within himself:] Shall he keep this [child] despite the contempt [which he feels for it]-or shall he bury it in the dust? Old, evil indeed is whatever they decide!

ayahs.textArabic: لِلَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ مَثَلُ السَّوْءِۚ وَلِلّٰهِ الْمَثَلُ الْاَعْلٰىۗ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Lil-lażīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati maṡalus-sau'(i), wa lillāhil-maṡalul-a‘lā, wa huwal-‘azīzul-ḥakīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Thus it is that] the attribute of evil applies to all who do not believe in the life to come -whereas unto God applies the attribute of all that is most sublime: for He alone is almighty, truly wise!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ اللّٰهُ النَّاسَ بِظُلْمِهِمْ مَّا تَرَكَ عَلَيْهَا مِنْ دَاۤبَّةٍ وَّلٰكِنْ يُّؤَخِّرُهُمْ اِلٰٓى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّىۚ فَاِذَا جَاۤءَ اَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَأْخِرُوْنَ سَاعَةً  وَّلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lau yu'ākhiżullāhun-nāsa biẓulmihim mā taraka ‘alaihā min dābbatiw wa lākiy yu'akhkhiruhum ilā ajalim musammā(n), fa iżā jā'a ajaluhum lā yasta'khirūna sā‘ataw wa lā yastaqdimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now if God were to take men [immediately] to task for all the evil that they do [on earth], He would not leave a single living creature upon its face. However, He grants them respite until a term set [by Him]: but when the end of their term approaches, they can neither delay it by a single moment, nor can they hasten it.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَجْعَلُوْنَ لِلّٰهِ مَا يَكْرَهُوْنَ وَتَصِفُ اَلْسِنَتُهُمُ الْكَذِبَ اَنَّ لَهُمُ الْحُسْنٰى لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّ لَهُمُ النَّارَ وَاَنَّهُمْ مُّفْرَطُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yaj‘alūna lillāhi mā yakrahūna wa taṣifu alsinatuhumul-każiba anna lahumul-ḥusnā lā jarama anna lahumun nāra  wa annahum mufraṭūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: As it is, they ascribe to God something that they [themselves] dislike -and [all the while] their tongues utter the lie that [by doing so] they earn supreme merit! Truly, they earn but the fire, and will be left out [of God's grace]!

ayahs.textArabic: تَاللّٰهِ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَآ اِلٰٓى اُمَمٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطٰنُ اَعْمَالَهُمْ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ الْيَوْمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Tallāhi laqad arsalnā ilā umamim min qablika fa zayyana lahumusy-syaiṭānu a‘mālahum fa huwa waliyyuhumul-yauma wa lahum ‘ażābun alīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: By God, [O Prophet,] even before thy time have We sent apostles unto [various] communities: but [those who were bent on denying the truth have always refused to listen to Our messages because] Satan has made all their own doings seem goodly to them: and he is [as] close to them today [as he was to the sinners of yore]; hence, grievous suffering awaits them.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ اِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِى اخْتَلَفُوْا فِيْهِۙ وَهُدًى وَّرَحْمَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يُّؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā anzalnā ‘alaikal-kitāba illā litubayyina lahumul-lażikhtalafū fīh(i), wa hudaw wa raḥmatal liqaumiy yu'minūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And upon thee [too] have We bestowed from on' high this divine writ for no other reason than that thou might make clear unto them all [questions of faith] on which they have come to hold divergent views, and [thus offer] guidance and grace unto people who will believe.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاللّٰهُ اَنْزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَاۤءِ مَاۤءً فَاَحْيَا بِهِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَاۗ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَّسْمَعُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wallāhu anzala minas-samā'i mā'an fa aḥyā bihil-arḍa ba‘da mautihā, inna fī żālika la'āyatal liqaumiy yasma‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND GOD sends down water from the skies, giving life thereby to the earth after it had been lifeless: in this, behold, there is a message indeed for people who [are willing to] listen.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى الْاَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةً ۚ نُسْقِيْكُمْ مِّمَّا فِيْ بُطُوْنِهٖ مِنْۢ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍ وَّدَمٍ لَّبَنًا خَالِصًا سَاۤىِٕغًا لِّلشّٰرِبِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa inna lakum fil-an‘āmi la‘ibrah(tan), nusqīkum mimmā fī buṭūnihī mim baini farṡiw wa damil labanan khāliṣan sā'igal lisy-syāribīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And, behold, in the cattle [too] there is indeed a lesson for you: We give you to drink of that [fluid] which is [secreted from] within their bellies between that which is to be eliminated [from the animal's body] and [its] life-blood: milk pure and pleasant to those who drink it.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِنْ ثَمَرٰتِ النَّخِيْلِ وَالْاَعْنَابِ تَتَّخِذُوْنَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًا وَّرِزْقًا حَسَنًاۗ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَّعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa min ṡamarātin nakhīli wal-a‘nābi tattakhiżūna minhu sakaraw wa rizqan ḥasanā(n), inna fī żālika la'āyatal liqaumiy ya‘qilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [We grant you nourishment] from the fruit of date-palms and vines: from it you derive intoxicants as well as wholesome sustenance -in this, behold, there is a message indeed for people who use their reason!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَوْحٰى رَبُّكَ اِلَى النَّحْلِ اَنِ اتَّخِذِيْ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوْتًا وَّمِنَ الشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa auḥā rabbuka ilan-naḥli anittakhiżī minal-jibāli buyūtaw wa minasy-syajari wa mimmā ya‘risyūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [consider how] thy Sustainer has inspired the bee: "Prepare for thyself dwellings in mountains and in trees, and in what [men] may build [for thee by way of hives];

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ كُلِيْ مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِ فَاسْلُكِيْ سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًاۗ يَخْرُجُ مِنْۢ بُطُوْنِهَا شَرَابٌ مُّخْتَلِفٌ اَلْوَانُهٗ ۖفِيْهِ شِفَاۤءٌ لِّلنَّاسِۗ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma kulī min kulliṡ-ṡamarāti faslukī subula rabbiki żululā(n), yakhruju mim buṭūnihā syarābum mukhtalifun alwānuhū fīhi syifā'ul lin-nās(i), inna fī żālika la'āyatal liqaumiy yatafakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and then eat of all manner of fruit, and follow humbly the paths ordained for thee by thy Sustainer." [And lo!] there issues from within these [bees] a fluid of many hues, wherein there is health for man. In all this, behold, there is a message indeed for people who think!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاللّٰهُ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفّٰىكُمْ وَمِنْكُمْ مَّنْ يُّرَدُّ اِلٰٓى اَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ لِكَيْ لَا يَعْلَمَ بَعْدَ عِلْمٍ شَيْـًٔاۗ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيْمٌ قَدِيْرٌ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wallāhu khalaqakum ṡumma yatawaffākum wa minkum may yuraddu ilā arżalil-‘umuri  likai lā ya‘lama ba‘da ‘ilmin syai'ā(n), innallāha ‘alīmun qadīr(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND GOD has created you, and in time will cause you to die; and many a one of you is reduced in old age to a most abject state, ceasing to know anything of what he once knew so well. Verily, God is all-knowing, infinite in His power!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاللّٰهُ فَضَّلَ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلٰى بَعْضٍ فِى الرِّزْقِۚ فَمَا الَّذِيْنَ فُضِّلُوْا بِرَاۤدِّيْ رِزْقِهِمْ عَلٰى مَا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَانُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِيْهِ سَوَاۤءٌۗ اَفَبِنِعْمَةِ اللّٰهِ يَجْحَدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wallāhu faḍḍala ba‘ḍakum ‘alā ba‘ḍin fir-rizq(i), famal-lażīna fuḍḍilū birāddī rizqihim ‘alā mā malakat aimānuhum fahum fīhi sawā'un afa bini‘matillāhi yajḥadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And on some of you God has bestowed more abundant means of sustenance than on others: and yet, they who are more abundantly favoured are [often] unwilling to share their sustenance with those whom their right hands possess, so that they [all] might be equal in this respect. Will they, then, God's blessings [thus] deny?

ayahs.textArabic: وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنْ اَنْفُسِكُمْ اَزْوَاجًا وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنْ اَزْوَاجِكُمْ بَنِيْنَ وَحَفَدَةً وَّرَزَقَكُمْ مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِۗ اَفَبِالْبَاطِلِ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ وَبِنِعْمَتِ اللّٰهِ هُمْ يَكْفُرُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wallāhu ja‘ala lakum min anfusikum azwājaw wa ja‘ala lakum min azwājikum banīna wa ḥafadataw wa razaqakum minaṭ-ṭayyibāt(i), afabil-bāṭili yu'minūna wa bini‘matillāhi yakfurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And God has given you mates of your own kinds and has given you, through your mates, children and children's children, and has provided for you sustenance out of the good things of life. Will men, then, [continue to] believe in things false and vain, and thus blaspheme against God's blessings? -

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ رِزْقًا مِّنَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ شَيْـًٔا وَّلَا يَسْتَطِيْعُوْنَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ya‘budūna min dūnillāhi mā lā yamliku lahum rizqam minas-samāwāti wal-arḍi syai'aw wa lā yastaṭī‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and will they [continue to] worship, instead of God, something that has it not within its power to provide for them any sustenance whatever from the heavens or the earth, and can do nothing at all?

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَا تَضْرِبُوْا لِلّٰهِ الْاَمْثَالَ ۗاِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعْلَمُ وَاَنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Falā taḍribū lillāhil-amṡāl(a), innallāha ya‘lamu wa antum lā ta‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, do not coin any similitudes for Gods Verily, God knows [all], whereas you have no [real] knowledge.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ ضَرَبَ اللّٰهُ مَثَلًا عَبْدًا مَّمْلُوْكًا لَّا يَقْدِرُ عَلٰى شَيْءٍ وَّمَنْ رَّزَقْنٰهُ مِنَّا رِزْقًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ يُنْفِقُ مِنْهُ سِرًّا وَّجَهْرًاۗ هَلْ يَسْتَوٗنَ ۚ اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ ۗبَلْ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ḍaraballāhu maṡalan ‘abdam mamlūkal lā yaqdiru ‘alā syai'iw wa mar razaqnāhu minnā rizqan ḥasanan fa huwa yunfiqu minhu sirraw wa jahrā(n), hal yastawūn(a), al-ḥamdu lillāh(i), bal akṡaruhum lā ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: God propounds [to you] the parable of [two men-] a man enslaved, unable to do anything of his own accord, and a [free] man upon whom We have bestowed goodly sustenance [as a gift] from Ourselves, so that he can spend thereof [at will, both] secretly and openly. Can these [two] be deemed equal? All praise is due to God [alone]: but most of them do not understand it.

ayahs.textArabic: وَضَرَبَ اللّٰهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلَيْنِ اَحَدُهُمَآ اَبْكَمُ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلٰى شَيْءٍ وَّهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلٰى مَوْلٰىهُ ۗ اَيْنَمَا يُوَجِّهْهُّ لَا يَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ ۖهَلْ يَسْتَوِيْ هُوَۙ وَمَنْ يَّأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَهُوَ عَلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ḍaraballāhu maṡalar rajulaini aḥaduhumā abkamu lā yaqdiru ‘alā syai'iw wa huwa kallun ‘alā maulāh(u), ainamā yuwajjihhu lā ya'ti bikhair(in), hal yastawī huw(a), wa may ya'muru bil-‘adli wa huwa ‘alā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And God propounds [to you] the parable of two [other] men -one of them dumb, unable to do anything of his own accord, and a sheer burden on his master: to whichever task the latter directs him, he accomplishes no good. Can such a one be considered the equal of [a wise man] who enjoins the doing of what is right and himself follows a straight way?

ayahs.textArabic: وَلِلّٰهِ غَيْبُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِۗ وَمَآ اَمْرُ السَّاعَةِ اِلَّا كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ اَوْ هُوَ اَقْرَبُۗ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lillāhi gaibus-samāwāti wal-arḍ(i), wa mā amrus-sā‘ati illā kalamḥil-baṣari au huwa aqrab(u), innallāha ‘alā kulli syai'in qadīr(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And, God's [alone] is the knowledge of the hidden reality of the heavens and the earth. And so, the advent of the Last Hour will but manifest itself [in a single moment,] like the twinkling of an eye, or closer still: for, behold, God has the power to will anything.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاللّٰهُ اَخْرَجَكُمْ مِّنْۢ بُطُوْنِ اُمَّهٰتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ شَيْـًٔاۙ وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْاَبْصَارَ وَالْاَفْـِٕدَةَ ۙ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wallāhu akhrajakum mim buṭūni ummahātikum lā ta‘lamūna syai'ā(n), wa ja‘ala lakumus-sam‘a wal-abṣāra wal-af'idah(ta), la‘allakum tasykurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And God has brought you forth from your mothers' wombs knowing nothing-but He has endowed you with hearing, and sight, and minds, so that you might have cause to be grateful.

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَمْ يَرَوْا اِلَى الطَّيْرِ مُسَخَّرٰتٍ فِيْ جَوِّ السَّمَاۤءِ ۗمَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ ۗاِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُّؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Alam yarau ilaṭ-ṭairi musakhkharātin fī jawwis-samā'(i), mā yumsikuhunna illallāh(u), inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy yu'minūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Have, then, they [who deny the truth] never considered the birds, enabled [by God] to fly in mid-air, with none but God holding them aloft? In this, behold, there are messages indeed for people who will believe!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنْۢ بُيُوْتِكُمْ سَكَنًا وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنْ جُلُوْدِ الْاَنْعَامِ بُيُوْتًا تَسْتَخِفُّوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ اِقَامَتِكُمْ ۙ وَمِنْ اَصْوَافِهَا وَاَوْبَارِهَا وَاَشْعَارِهَآ اَثَاثًا وَّمَتَاعًا اِلٰى حِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wallāhu ja‘ala lakum mim buyūtikum sakanaw wa ja‘ala lakum min julūdil-an‘āmi buyūtan tastakhiffūnahā yauma ẓa‘nikum wa yauma iqāmatikum, wa min aṣwāfihā wa aubārihā wa asy‘ārihā aṡāṡaw wa matā‘an ilā ḥīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And God has given you [the ability to build] your houses as places of rest, and has endowed you with [the skill to make] dwellings out of the skins of animals - easy for you to handle when you travel and when you camp -and [to make] furnishings and goods for temporary use of their [rough] wool and their soft, furry wool and their hair.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلٰلًا وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ الْجِبَالِ اَكْنَانًا وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمْ سَرَابِيْلَ تَقِيْكُمُ الْحَرَّ وَسَرَابِيْلَ تَقِيْكُمْ بَأْسَكُمْ ۚ  كَذٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهٗ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wallāhu ja‘ala lakum mimmā khalaqa ẓilālaw wa ja‘ala lakum minal-jibāli aknānaw wa ja‘ala lakum sarābīla taqīkumul-ḥarra wa sarābīla taqīkum ba'sakum, każālika yutimmu ni‘matahū ‘alaikum la‘allakum tuslimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And among the many objects of His creation, God has appointed for you [various] means of protection: thus, He has given you in the mountains places of shelter, and has endowed you with [the ability to make] garments to protect you from heat [and cold], as well as such garments as might protect you from your [mutual] violence. In this way does He bestow the full measure of His blessings on you, so that you might surrender yourselves unto Him.

ayahs.textArabic: فَاِنْ تَوَلَّوْا فَاِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ الْبَلٰغُ الْمُبِيْنُ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa in tawallau fa innamā ‘alaikal-balāgul-mubīn(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: BUT IF they turn away [from thee, O Prophet, remember that] thy only duty is a clear delivery of the message [entrusted to thee].

ayahs.textArabic: يَعْرِفُوْنَ نِعْمَتَ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ يُنْكِرُوْنَهَا وَاَكْثَرُهُمُ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Ya‘rifūna ni‘matallāhi ṡumma yunkirūnahā wa akṡaruhumul-kāfirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They [who turn away from it] are fully aware of God's blessings, but none the less they refuse to acknowledge them [as such], since most of them are given to denying the truth.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ مِنْ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ شَهِيْدًا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤْذَنُ لِلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yauma nab‘aṡu min kulli ummatin syahīdan ṡumma lā yu'żanu lil-lażīna kafarū wa lā hum yusta‘tabūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But one Day We shall raise up a witness out of every community, whereupon they who were bent on denying the truth will not be allowed to plead [ignorance], and neither will they be allowed to make amends.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَا رَاَ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوا الْعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْظَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā ra'al-lażīna ẓalamul-‘ażāba falā yukhaffafu ‘anhum wa lā hum yunẓarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And when they who were bent on evildoing behold the suffering [that awaits them, they will realize that] it will not be lightened for them [by virtue of their pleading]; and neither will they be granted respite.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَا رَاَ الَّذِيْنَ اَشْرَكُوْا شُرَكَاۤءَهُمْ قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ شُرَكَاۤؤُنَا الَّذِيْنَ كُنَّا نَدْعُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِكَۚ فَاَلْقَوْا اِلَيْهِمُ الْقَوْلَ اِنَّكُمْ لَكٰذِبُوْنَۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā ra'al-lażīna asyrakū syurakā'ahum qālū rabbanā hā'ulā'i syurakā'unal-lażīna kunnā nad‘ū min dūnik(a), fa alqau ilaihimul-qaula innakum lakāżibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And when they who were wont to ascribe divinity to beings other than God behold [on Judgment Day] those beings to whom they were wont to ascribe a share in His divinity, they will exclaim: "O our Sustainer! These are the beings to whom we ascribed a share in Thy divinity, and whom we were wont to invoke instead of Thee!" -whereupon [those beings] will fling at them the retort: "Behold, you have indeed been lying [to yourselves]!"

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَلْقَوْا اِلَى اللّٰهِ يَوْمَىِٕذِ ِۨالسَّلَمَ وَضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يَفْتَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa alqau ilallāhi yauma'iżinis-salama wa ḍalla ‘anhum mā kānū yaftarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And on that Day will they [who had thus been sinning, belatedly] proffer their surrender to God; and all their false imagery will have forsaken them.

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَصَدُّوْا عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ زِدْنٰهُمْ عَذَابًا فَوْقَ الْعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوْا يُفْسِدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażīna kafarū wa ṣaddū ‘an sabīlillāhi zidnāhum ‘ażāban fauqal-‘ażābi bimā kānū yufsidūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Upon all who were bent on denying the truth and who turned others away from the path of God will We heap suffering upon suffering in return for all the corruption that they wrought:

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ فِيْ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ شَهِيْدًا عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنْ اَنْفُسِهِمْ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ شَهِيْدًا عَلٰى هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِۗ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْكِتٰبَ تِبْيَانًا لِّكُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَّهُدًى وَّرَحْمَةً وَّبُشْرٰى لِلْمُسْلِمِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yauma nab‘aṡu fī kulli ummatin syahīdan ‘alaihim min anfusihim wa ji'nā bika syahīdan ‘alā hā'ulā'(i), wa nazzalnā ‘alaikal-kitāba tibyānal likulli syai'iw wa hudaw wa raḥmataw wa busyrā lil-muslimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for one Day We shall raise up within every community a witness against them from among themselves. And thee [too, O Prophet,] have We brought forth to bear witness regarding those [whom thy message may have reached], inasmuch as We have bestowed from on high upon thee, step by step, this divine writ, to make everything clear, and to provide guidance and grace and a glad tiding unto all who have surrendered themselves to God.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَأْمُرُ بِالْعَدْلِ وَالْاِحْسَانِ وَاِيْتَاۤئِ ذِى الْقُرْبٰى وَيَنْهٰى عَنِ الْفَحْشَاۤءِ وَالْمُنْكَرِ وَالْبَغْيِ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Innallāha ya'muru bil-‘adli wal-iḥsāni wa ītā'i żil-qurbā wa yanhā ‘anil-faḥsyā'i wal-munkari wal-bagyi ya‘iẓukum la‘allakum tażakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: BEHOLD, God enjoins justice, and the doing of good, and generosity towards [one's] fellow-men; and He forbids all that is shameful and all that runs counter to reason, as well as envy; [and] He exhorts you [repeatedly] so that you might bear [all this] in mind.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَوْفُوْا بِعَهْدِ اللّٰهِ اِذَا عَاهَدْتُّمْ وَلَا تَنْقُضُوا الْاَيْمَانَ بَعْدَ تَوْكِيْدِهَا وَقَدْ جَعَلْتُمُ اللّٰهَ عَلَيْكُمْ كَفِيْلًا ۗاِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa aufū bi‘ahdillāhi iżā ‘āhattum wa lā tanquḍul-aimāna ba‘da taukīdihā wa qad ja‘altumullāha ‘alaikum kafīlā(n), innallāha ya‘lamu mā taf‘alūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And be true to your bond with God whenever you bind yourselves by a pledge, and do not break [your] oaths after having [freely] confirmed them and having called upon God to be witness to your good faith: behold, God knows all that you do.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تَكُوْنُوْا كَالَّتِيْ نَقَضَتْ غَزْلَهَا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ اَنْكَاثًاۗ تَتَّخِذُوْنَ اَيْمَانَكُمْ دَخَلًا ۢ بَيْنَكُمْ اَنْ تَكُوْنَ اُمَّةٌ هِيَ اَرْبٰى مِنْ اُمَّةٍ ۗاِنَّمَا يَبْلُوْكُمُ اللّٰهُ بِهٖۗ وَلَيُبَيِّنَنَّ لَكُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ مَا كُنْتُمْ فِيْهِ تَخْتَلِفُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lā takūnū kal-latī naqaḍat gazlahā mim ba‘di quwwatin ankāṡā(n), tattakhiżūna aimānakum dakhalam bainakum an takūna ummatun hiya arbā min ummah(tin), innamā yablūkumullāhu bih(ī), wa layubayyinanna lakum yaumal-qiyāmati mā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, be not like her who breaks and completely untwists the yarn which she [herself] has spun and made strong-[be not like this by] using your oaths as a means of deceiving one another, simply because some of you may be more powerful than others." By all this, God but puts you to a test-and [He does it] so that on Resurrection Day He might make clear unto you all that on which you were wont to differ.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوْ شَاۤءَ اللّٰهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّلٰكِنْ يُّضِلُّ مَنْ يَّشَاۤءُ وَيَهْدِيْ مَنْ يَّشَاۤءُۗ وَلَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lau syā'allāhu laja‘alakum ummataw wāḥidataw wa lākiy yuḍillu may yasyā'u wa yahdī may yasyā'(u), wa latus'alunna ‘ammā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: For, had God so willed, He could surely have made you all one single community; however, He lets go astray him that wills [to go astray], and guides aright him that wills [to be guided]; and you will surely be called to account for all that you ever did!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوْٓا اَيْمَانَكُمْ دَخَلًا ۢ بَيْنَكُمْ فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌۢ بَعْدَ ثُبُوْتِهَا وَتَذُوْقُوا السُّوْۤءَ بِمَا صَدَدْتُّمْ عَنْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِ ۚوَلَكُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lā tattakhiżū aimānakum dakhalam bainakum fa tazilla qadamum ba‘da ṡubūtihā wa tażūqus-sū'a bimā ṣadattum ‘an sabīlillāh(i), wa lakum ‘ażābun ‘aẓīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And do not use your oaths as a means of deceiving one another-or else [your] foot will slip after having been firm, and then you will have to taste the evil [consequences] of your having turned away from the path of God, with tremendous suffering awaiting you [in the life to come].

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تَشْتَرُوْا بِعَهْدِ اللّٰهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيْلًاۗ اِنَّمَا عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lā tasytarū bi‘ahdillāhi ṡamanan qalīlā(n), innamā ‘indallāhi huwa khairul lakum  in kuntum ta‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, do not barter away your bond with God for a trifling gain! Verily, that which is with God is by far the best for you, if you but knew it:

ayahs.textArabic: مَا عِنْدَكُمْ يَنْفَدُ وَمَا عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ بَاقٍۗ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّ الَّذِيْنَ صَبَرُوْٓا اَجْرَهُمْ بِاَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā ‘indakum yanfadu wa mā ‘indallāhi bāq(in), wa lanajziyannal-lażīna ṣabarū ajrahum bi'aḥsani mā kānū ya‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: all that is with you is bound to come to an end, whereas that which is with God is everlasting. And most certainly shall We grant unto those who are patient in adversity their reward in accordance with the best that they ever did.

ayahs.textArabic: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِّنْ ذَكَرٍ اَوْ اُنْثٰى وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهٗ حَيٰوةً طَيِّبَةًۚ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ اَجْرَهُمْ بِاَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Man ‘amila ṣāliḥam min żakarin au unṡā wa huwa mu'minun fa lanuḥyiyannahū ḥayātan ṭayyibah(tan), wa lanajziyannahum ajrahum bi'aḥsani mā kānū ya‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: As for anyone - be it man or woman - who does righteous deeds, and is a believer withal - him shall We most certainly cause to live a good life. and most certainly shall We grant unto such as these their reward in accordance with the best that they ever did.

ayahs.textArabic: فَاِذَا قَرَأْتَ الْقُرْاٰنَ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطٰنِ الرَّجِيْمِ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa iżā qara'tal-qur'āna fasta‘iż billāhi minasy-syaiṭānir-rajīm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: NOW whenever thou happen to read this Qur'an, seek refuge with God from Satan, the accursed.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّهٗ لَيْسَ لَهٗ سُلْطٰنٌ عَلَى الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَلٰى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Innahū laisa lahū sulṭānun ‘alal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘alā rabbihim yatawakkalūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, he has no power over those who have attained to faith and in their Sustainer place their tray trust:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّمَا سُلْطٰنُهٗ عَلَى الَّذِيْنَ يَتَوَلَّوْنَهٗ وَالَّذِيْنَ هُمْ بِهٖ مُشْرِكُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Innamā sulṭānuhū ‘alal-lażīna yatawallaunahū wal-lażīna hum bihī musyrikūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: he has power only over those who are willing to follow him, and who [thus] ascribe to him a share in God's divinity.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَا بَدَّلْنَآ اٰيَةً مَّكَانَ اٰيَةٍ ۙوَّاللّٰهُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُنَزِّلُ قَالُوْٓا اِنَّمَآ اَنْتَ مُفْتَرٍۗ بَلْ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā baddalnā āyatam makāna āyah(tin), wallāhu a‘lamu bimā yunazzilu qālū innamā anta muftar(in), bal akṡaruhum lā ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And now that We replace one message by another -since God is fully aware of what He bestows from on high, step by step - they [who deny the truth] are wont to say, "Thou but inventest it!" Nay, but most of them do not understand it!

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ نَزَّلَهٗ رُوْحُ الْقُدُسِ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ بِالْحَقِّ لِيُثَبِّتَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَهُدًى وَّبُشْرٰى لِلْمُسْلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul nazzalahū rūḥul-qudusi mir rabbika bil-ḥaqqi liyuṡabbital-lażīna āmanū wa hudaw wa busyrā lil-muslimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: "Holy inspiration has brought it down from thy Sustainer by stages, setting forth the truth, so that it might give firmness unto those who have attained to faith, and provide guidance and a glad tiding unto all who have surrendered themselves to God."

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ اَنَّهُمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ اِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهٗ بَشَرٌۗ لِسَانُ الَّذِيْ يُلْحِدُوْنَ اِلَيْهِ اَعْجَمِيٌّ وَّهٰذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِيٌّ مُّبِيْنٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad na‘lamu annahum yaqūlūna innamā yu‘allimuhū basyar(un), lisānul-lażī yulḥidūna ilaihi a‘jamiyyuw wa hāżā lisānun ‘arabiyyum mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And, indeed, full well do We know that they say, "It is but a human being that imparts [all] this to him! -[notwithstanding that] the tongue of him to whom they so maliciously point is wholly outlandish, whereas this is Arabic speech, clear [in itself] and clearly showing the truth [of its source].

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِۙ لَا يَهْدِيْهِمُ اللّٰهُ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-lażīna lā yu'minūna bi'āyātillāh(i), lā yahdīhimullāhu wa lahum ‘ażābun alīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, as for those who will not believe in God's messages, God does not guide them aright; and grievous suffering will be their lot [in the life to come].

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّمَا يَفْتَرِى الْكَذِبَ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِۚ وَاُولٰۤىِٕكَ هُمُ الْكٰذِبُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Innamā yaftaril-każibal-lażīna lā yu'minūna bi'āyātillāh(i), ulā'ika humul-kāżibūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: It is but they who will not believe in God's messages that invent this falsehood; and it is they, they who are lying!

ayahs.textArabic: مَنْ كَفَرَ بِاللّٰهِ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ اِيْمَانِهٖٓ اِلَّا مَنْ اُكْرِهَ وَقَلْبُهٗ مُطْمَىِٕنٌّۢ بِالْاِيْمَانِ وَلٰكِنْ مَّنْ شَرَحَ بِالْكُفْرِ صَدْرًا فَعَلَيْهِمْ غَضَبٌ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ ۗوَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Man kafara billāhi mim ba‘di īmānihī illā man ukriha wa qalbuhū muṭma'innum bil-īmāni wa lākim man syaraḥa bil-kufri ṣadran fa ‘alaihim gaḍabum minallāh(i), wa lahum ‘ażābun aẓīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: As for anyone who denies God after having once attained to faith-and this, to be sure, does not apply to one who does it under duress, the while his heart remains true to his faith, but [only, to] him who willingly opens up his heart to a denial of the truth-: upon all such [falls] God's condemnation, and tremendous suffering awaits them:

ayahs.textArabic: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمُ اسْتَحَبُّوا الْحَيٰوةَ الدُّنْيَا عَلَى الْاٰخِرَةِۙ وَاَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهْدِى الْقَوْمَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Żālika bi'annahumustaḥabbul-ḥayātad-dun-yā ‘alal-ākhirah(ti), wa annallāha lā yahdil-qaumal-kāfirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: all this, because they hold this world's life in greater esteem than the life to come, and because God does not bestow His guidance upon people who deny the truth.

ayahs.textArabic: اُولٰۤىِٕكَ الَّذِيْنَ طَبَعَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى قُلُوْبِهِمْ وَسَمْعِهِمْ وَاَبْصَارِهِمْۗ وَاُولٰۤىِٕكَ هُمُ الْغٰفِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ulā'ikal-lażīna ṭaba‘allāhu ‘alā qulūbihim wa sam‘ihim wa abṣārihim, wa ulā'ika humul-gāfilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They whose hearts and whose hearing and whose sight God has sealed -it is they, they who are heedless!

ayahs.textArabic: لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّهُمْ فِى الْاٰخِرَةِ هُمُ الْخٰسِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Lā jarama annahum fil-ākhirati humul-khāsirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Truly it is they, they who in the life to come shall be the losers!

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِيْنَ هَاجَرُوْا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا فُتِنُوْا ثُمَّ جَاهَدُوْا وَصَبَرُوْاۚ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma inna rabbaka lil-lażīna hājarū mim ba‘di mā futinū ṡumma jāhadū wa ṣabarū, inna rabbaka mim ba‘dihā lagafūrur raḥīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And yet, behold, thy Sustainer [grants His forgiveness] unto those who forsake the domain of evil after having succumbed to its temptation, and who thenceforth strive hard [in God's cause] and are patient in adversity: behold, after such [repentance] thy Sustainer is indeed much-forgiving, a dispenser of grace!

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ يَوْمَ تَأْتِيْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ تُجَادِلُ عَنْ نَّفْسِهَا وَتُوَفّٰى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yauma ta'tī kullu nafsin tujādilu ‘an nafsihā wa tuwaffā kullu nafsim mā ‘amilat wa hum lā yuẓlamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Be conscious, then, of] the Day when every human being shall come to plead for himself [alone], and every human being shall be repaid in full for whatever he has done, and none shall be wronged.

ayahs.textArabic: وَضَرَبَ اللّٰهُ مَثَلًا قَرْيَةً كَانَتْ اٰمِنَةً مُّطْمَىِٕنَّةً يَّأْتِيْهَا رِزْقُهَا رَغَدًا مِّنْ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ فَكَفَرَتْ بِاَنْعُمِ اللّٰهِ فَاَذَاقَهَا اللّٰهُ لِبَاسَ الْجُوْعِ وَالْخَوْفِ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَصْنَعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ḍaraballāhu maṡalan qaryatan kānat āminatam muṭma'innatay ya'tīhā rizquhā ragadam min kulli makānin fa kafarat bi'an‘umillāhi fa ażāqahallāhu libāsal-jū‘i wal-khaufi bimā kānū yaṣna‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND GOD propounds [to you] a parable: [Imagine] a town which was [once] secure and at ease, with its sustenance coming to it abundantly from all quarters, and which thereupon blasphemously refused to show gratitude for God's blessings: and therefore God caused it to taste the all-embracing misery of hunger and fear in result of all [the evil] that its people had so persistently wrought.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ جَاۤءَهُمْ رَسُوْلٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَكَذَّبُوْهُ فَاَخَذَهُمُ الْعَذَابُ وَهُمْ ظٰلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad jā'ahum rasūlum minhum fa każżabūhu fa akhażahumul-‘ażābu wa hum ẓālimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And indeed, there had come unto them an apostle from among themselves -but they gave him the lie; and therefore suffering overwhelmed them while they were thus doing wrong [to themselves].

ayahs.textArabic: فَكُلُوْا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللّٰهُ حَلٰلًا طَيِّبًاۖ وَّاشْكُرُوْا نِعْمَتَ اللّٰهِ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ اِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa kulū mimmā razaqakumullāhu ḥalālan ṭayyibā(n), wasykurū ni‘matallāhi in kuntum iyyāhu ta‘budūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND SO, partake of all the lawful, good things which God has provided for you as sustenance, and render thanks unto God for His blessings, if it is [truly] Him that you worship.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَيْتَةَ وَالدَّمَ وَلَحْمَ الْخِنْزِيْرِ وَمَآ اُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ اللّٰهِ بِهٖۚ فَمَنِ اضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَّلَا عَادٍ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Innamā ḥarrama ‘alaikumul-maitata wad-dama wa laḥmal-khinzīri wa mā uhilla ligairillāhi bih(ī), famaniḍṭurra gaira bāgiw wa lā ‘ādin fa innallāha gafūrur raḥīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: He has forbidden to you only carrion, and blood, and the flesh of swine, and that over which any name other than God's has been invoked; but if one is driven [to it] by necessity - neither coveting it nor exceeding his immediate need -verily, God is much forgiving, a dispenser of grace.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تَقُوْلُوْا لِمَا تَصِفُ اَلْسِنَتُكُمُ الْكَذِبَ هٰذَا حَلٰلٌ وَّهٰذَا حَرَامٌ لِّتَفْتَرُوْا عَلَى اللّٰهِ الْكَذِبَۗ اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يَفْتَرُوْنَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ الْكَذِبَ لَا يُفْلِحُوْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lā taqūlū limā taṣifu alsinatukumul-każiba hāżā ḥalāluw wa hāżā ḥarāmul litaftarū ‘alallāhil-każib(a), innal-lażīna yaftarūna ‘alallāhil-każiba lā yufliḥūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, do not utter falsehoods by letting your tongues determine [at your own discretion], "This is lawful and that is forbidden", thus attributing your own lying inventions to God: for, behold, they who attribute their own lying inventions to God will never attain to a happy state!

ayahs.textArabic: مَتَاعٌ قَلِيْلٌ  ۖوَّلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Matā‘un qalīl(un), wa lahum ‘ażābun alīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: A brief enjoyment [may be theirs in this world] -but grievous suffering awaits them [in the life to come]!

ayahs.textArabic: وَعَلَى الَّذِيْنَ هَادُوْا حَرَّمْنَا مَا قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ ۗوَمَا ظَلَمْنٰهُمْ وَلٰكِنْ كَانُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ‘alal-lażīna hādū ḥarramnā mā qaṣaṣnā ‘alaika min qabl(u), wa mā ẓalamnāhum wa lākin kānū anfusahum yaẓlimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [only] unto those who followed the Jewish faith did We forbid all that We have mentioned to thee ere this; and no wrong did We do to them, but it was they who persistently wronged themselves.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِيْنَ عَمِلُوا السُّوْۤءَ بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابُوْا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ ذٰلِكَ وَاَصْلَحُوْٓا اِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma inna rabbaka lil-lażīna ‘amilus-sū'a bijahālatin ṡumma tābū mim ba‘di żālika wa aṣlaḥū inna rabbaka mim ba‘dihā lagafūrur raḥīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And once again: Behold, thy Sustainer [shows mercy] to those who do evil out of ignorance and afterwards repent and live righteously: behold, after such [repentance] thy Sustainer is indeed much forgiving, a dispenser of grace.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ كَانَ اُمَّةً قَانِتًا لِّلّٰهِ حَنِيْفًاۗ وَلَمْ يَكُ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna ibrāhīma kāna ummatan qānital lillāhi ḥanīfā(n), wa lam yaku minal-musyrikīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: VERILY, Abraham was a man who combined within himself all virtues, devoutly obeying God's will, turning away from all that is false, and not being of those who ascribe divinity to aught beside God:

ayahs.textArabic: شَاكِرًا لِّاَنْعُمِهِ ۖاجْتَبٰىهُ وَهَدٰىهُ اِلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Syākiral li'an‘umih(ī), ijtabāhu wa hadāhu ilā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: [for he was always] grateful for the blessings granted by Him who had elected him and guided him onto a straight way.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاٰتَيْنٰهُ فِى الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً ۗوَاِنَّهٗ فِى الْاٰخِرَةِ لَمِنَ الصّٰلِحِيْنَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ātaināhu fid-dun-yā ḥasanah(tan), wa innahū fil-ākhirati laminaṣ-ṣāliḥīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so We vouchsafed him good in this world; and, verily, in the life to come [too] he shall find himself among the righteous.

ayahs.textArabic: ثُمَّ اَوْحَيْنَآ اِلَيْكَ اَنِ اتَّبِعْ مِلَّةَ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ حَنِيْفًا ۗوَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṡumma auḥainā ilaika anittabi‘ millata ibrāhīma ḥanīfā(n), wa mā kāna minal-musyrikīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And lastly, We have inspired thee, [O Muhammad, with this message:] "Follow the creed of Abraham, who turned away from all that is false, and was not of those who ascribe divinity to aught beside God;

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّمَا جُعِلَ السَّبْتُ عَلَى الَّذِيْنَ اخْتَلَفُوْا فِيْهِۗ وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ فِيْمَا كَانُوْا فِيْهِ يَخْتَلِفُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Innamā ju‘ilas-sabtu ‘alal-lażīnakhtalafū fīh(i), wa inna rabbaka layaḥkumu bainahum yaumal-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and know that the observance of] the Sabbath was ordained only for those who came to hold divergent views about him; but, verily, God will judge between them on Resurrection Day with regard to all on which they were wont to differ.

ayahs.textArabic: اُدْعُ اِلٰى سَبِيْلِ رَبِّكَ بِالْحِكْمَةِ وَالْمَوْعِظَةِ الْحَسَنَةِ وَجَادِلْهُمْ بِالَّتِيْ هِيَ اَحْسَنُۗ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ ضَلَّ عَنْ سَبِيْلِهٖ وَهُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ud‘u ilā sabīli rabbika bil-ḥikmati wal-mau‘iẓatil-ḥasanati wa jādilhum bil-latī hiya aḥsan(u), inna rabbaka huwa a‘lamu biman ḍalla ‘an sabīlihī wa huwa a‘lamu bil-muhtadīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: CALL THOU (all mankind] unto thy Sustainer's path with wisdom and goodly exhortation, and argue with them in the most kindly manner- for, behold, thy Sustainer knows best as to who strays from His path, and best knows He as to who are the right-guided.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنْ عَاقَبْتُمْ فَعَاقِبُوْا بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوْقِبْتُمْ بِهٖۗ وَلَىِٕنْ صَبَرْتُمْ لَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لِّلصّٰبِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa in ‘āqabtum fa ‘āqibū bimiṡli mā ‘ūqibtum bih(ī), wa la'in ṣabartum lahuwa khairul liṣ-ṣābirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, if you have to respond to an attack (in argument], respond only to the extent of the attack levelled against you; but to bear yourselves with patience is indeed far better for (you, since God is with] those who are patient in adversity.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاصْبِرْ وَمَا صَبْرُكَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُ فِيْ ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Waṣbir wa mā ṣabruka illā billāhi wa lā taḥzan ‘alaihim wa lā taku fī ḍaiqim mimmā yamkurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Endure, then, with patience (all that they who deny the truth may say] -always remembering that it is none but God who gives thee the strength to endure adversity -and do not grieve over them, and neither be distressed by the false arguments which they devise:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ مَعَ الَّذِيْنَ اتَّقَوْا وَّالَّذِيْنَ هُمْ مُّحْسِنُوْنَ ࣖ   ۔
ayahs.textLatin: Innallāha ma‘al-lażīnattaqau wal-lażīna hum muḥsinūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, verily, God is with those who are conscious of Him and are doers of good withal!
